persona.backstory: A glassmaker's daughter on Murano, nineteen and already better at the furnace than her brother. The guild will not enrol a woman, so she works under her father's mark, keeps his recipe in her head, and watches the Rialto for the day a furnace of her own comes within reach.

wrote: 1350 Winter (t43, age 29) — NEAR BROKE:** Money hit rock bottom at 3 ducats after a season of heavy rest (only 2 work weeks) + "good" eating + medicine, following a fever crash. Health/energy fully recovered (100/99) but finances are in danger. CONFIRMED SUSTAINABLE PATTERN: work 6-9 weeks per season with "plain" eating is the stable default that grows money; only dip into "good" eating + heavy rest for at most ONE season when health/energy is critically low (below ~30), then immediately snap back to plain+work. Don't stack low-work + good-eating + medicine-buying for more than one season at a time.
Winter 1350: down to my last coins. Full health and energy though — back to hard work, plain food, no more excess.
retrieved: Money hit 3 ducats — urgent need to work hard again with plain eating.
Health and energy fully recovered, good time to work a full season.
Sustainable pattern: 6-9 work weeks + plain eating grows money; only dip into rest+good food for one season when truly needed.
